(2) Counts: it.skip 0, test.skip 0, .todo 0, test.fixme 1 (e2e/cursor-icons.spec.ts:79), TODO 1 (src/app/engine/systems/interceptionsSystem.ts:5), FIXME/HACK 0, [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] in 46 FR rows (43 of them say tested) and 13 src lines. findings.title: Three of the four minor nations can never be attacked or taken, but the game offers war on them
repro: Open http://localhost:3170/ and click Diplomacy, tab Lorran (or Sundmark, Pellis), Declare war, confirm, Advance Turn twice.
Click the Testland army marker on the capital (Army in Testland South-West) and open the "March to" list.
The list holds only Testland North-West, North-East and South-East. There is no way to reach Lorran. Repeat the check for Sundmark and Pellis: same.
Headless proof: run .gate/audit/fr-truth/probes/world.test.ts (npx vitest run --config .gate/audit/fr-truth/vitest.audit.config.ts probes/world).
findings.expected: M9 is called done with the goal "the human declares war on a minor, attacks, sees the battle and takes the province" (roadmap.json doneWhen, FR-233). A war on any of the 4 minors should be playable, or the Diplomacy screen should say a minor cannot be reached.
findings.actual: Only Arvelia has a land border (province-minor-1 touches Testland North-East and Valdoria North-West). Sundmark, Lorran and Pellis list adj=[] (no neighbouring province), because rail and sea moves of armies are not built (Q37). Declaring war on them only drops relations (news: "Relations with Lorran: yellow to dark brown") and ends trade; the player cannot act on the war. The Diplomacy war question does not warn about this.
findings.evidence: Probe output: "province-minor-2 Sundmark adj=[]", "province-minor-3 Lorran adj=[]", "province-minor-4 Pellis adj=[]", "DIRECT LAND BORDER nation-1 -> nation-2 provinces from: []". Tour output: March to options at capital: ["Testland North-West","Testland North-East","Testland South-East"]. Screenshot C:/Users/brnat/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/6d278f4c60cadc55/c11c618f-69f1-4659-b2b1-f3416944c4fb/scratchpad/audit/shots/fr-truth-08-army-war-lorran.png
findings.suspect: src/app/engine/world/continent.ts (minors 2 to 4 are islands) with src/app/engine/orders/armyOrders.ts:98 (a march needs an adjacent province); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Not on the engine yet" and card Q37 say sea moves stay out of v2.

findings.title: The Council of Governors vote can practically never end a game; every simulated game ends on turn 40
repro: Run: npx vitest run --config .gate/audit/fr-truth/vitest.audit.config.ts probes/seeds (about 55 s).
Read the line "RUNS 42 with something odd: 0" and the "both scripted" lines: every game ended by the turn limit and every meeting (turns 10, 20, 30, 40) says winner none.
In the app: play to turn 10, the Council screen says "No winner. The Council meets again on turn 20." and shows Abstained: 4 of 12.
findings.expected: NR-011 (a decision by Nathan): the game ends the way the original does, by a Council vote once one nation is strong enough. Roadmap M10 goal: "more than two thirds wins".
findings.actual: 12 votes, 9 needed. A nation holds 4 provinces, the 4 minors add at most 4 (Arvelia as a colony plus 3 free minors by relations), so 8 at most without taking a province from the rival Great Power. In 46 simulated games (4 pinned seeds from FR-305 plus 42 probe games on seeds 5 to 36, 10 of them with both nations scripted) no meeting ever gave a winner. Card Q51 states the same and is still open.
findings.evidence: Probe: "RUNS 42 with something odd: 0" (odd = any game not ending on the turn limit); FR-305 row: "each emit exactly 4 council-met events ... with no winner"; FR-304 row: "an idle player cannot reach 9 votes: it holds 4 provinces and the 4 minors give at most 4 more". Roadmap card Q51 status open. Screenshot C:/Users/brnat/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/6d278f4c60cadc55/c11c618f-69f1-4659-b2b1-f3416944c4fb/scratchpad/audit/shots/fr-truth-10-council-turn10.png
findings.suspect: src/app/definisions/council.ts and src/app/engine/council/council.ts:38 (votesNeeded = floor(2n/3)+1 with n = 12); decision Q51 (option: more than half, 7 of 12).

findings.title: There is no technology system; the Technology button is disabled and the Oil Refinery and Fuel can never be reached

The header button "Technology" is greyed out (title: "Coming in a later milestone"). The Industry panel has 7 cards and no Oil Refinery card.

findings.title: The status "tested" in requirements.md does not mean what a reader expects
repro: node .gate/audit/fr-truth/parse.js (parses all rows), then read rows.json statuses.
Check FR-199, FR-324, FR-337, FR-341, FR-345, FR-336 and NR-005 in docs/requirements.md.
findings.expected: FLOW.md: a changed requirement gets a new id and the old row says "replaced by FR-###"; status values are planned, tested, replaced, dropped.
findings.actual: 347 FR rows (the brief says about 356: ids FR-143 and FR-282 to FR-289 do not exist; FR-143 was deleted instead of marked dropped). Status is free text up to 1,804 characters. Only 19 rows start with "replaced", but 41 more rows say "tested" while a later row replaced their wording (e.g. FR-324 -> FR-347, FR-337 -> FR-339, FR-341 -> FR-346). 46 rows carry an open [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] and 43 of them say "tested": tested means "the code equals the row", not "the row equals the 1997 game" (FR-199: 5 of 9 regiment costs are "derived" or "low" confidence guesses). NR-005 (gold $200, gems $500) still says "planned" although cashValues.ts holds 200 and 500. FR-336 ("nothing else changes") was verified by a one-time git diff, not by a standing test.
findings.evidence: Parser output: 347 rows, 102 exactly "tested", 19 "replaced", 226 free text, 41 with "replaced by" inside the text; FR-143 removal in commit 6d4e223 "drop FR-143 (a process step, not a requirement)".
findings.suspect: docs/requirements.md status column; docs/FLOW.md "Requirement ids are permanent".

findings.title: The tile panel offers Construct Depot, Port and Fort on the capital, where all three are invalid; the refusal shows far away
repro: Open http://localhost:3170/ at 1280x720. Click the stack of civilians on the capital (tile 2-9) and pick the engineer.
Click the capital tile once more so the Tile Info panel shows (close the Army screen with Escape if it opens).
The buttons "Construct Depot", "Construct Port", "Construct Fort" are enabled (Construct Rail is greyed). Click each one.
Cash stays $10,000, no job starts, and the only feedback is the red line "Build refused: that tile is not a valid site." in the HUD under the panel.
findings.expected: A button that cannot work on this tile is disabled with a reason, as the Develop button is ("Resource not discovered - use Prospector first"). FR-030: construction sites are refused with invalid-site; the UI should not offer them.
